static_traits.name: Lin Peiran
static_traits.family_status: Lives with spouse and two children
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues marked by Self-doubt and comparison, leading to Tension, estrangement
static_traits.medical_history: Has not yet received psychotherapy; no similar psychological problems have occurred; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude, clear expression, able to describe problems concretely, willing to cooperate, tending toward Self-doubt and self-criticism

basic_info.main_problem: Although I can play multiple instruments, I cannot master any of them, which makes me feel frustrated and not good enough.
basic_info.core_demands: I hope to resolve my persistent sense of inferiority and rebuild confidence in my musical abilities; to be more confident when practicing or performing, compare myself with others less, and be able to 'complete a performance without self-criticism', enjoying music again.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough/not good enough

special_situations.event: Started teaching more advanced Students, directly seeing Students' high-level playing and technique
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Students are stronger than me, it proves I am not worthy of being a teacher; I must be stronger than Students to be competent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Setting unrealistic goals, practicing overtime to prove myself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will see that I am not good enough; I will be exposed

special_situations.event: Some mistakes occur or difficult passages are encountered during practice or performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot play perfectly, it means I have not truly mastered any instrument
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Practices repeatedly to perfection, harsh self-criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have not mastered any instrument at all

special_situations.event: Comparing with colleagues or Students, seeing their strengths and achievements
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others being better than me means I am not good enough; I should not enjoy music
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeking others' approval to ease Anxiety, while reducing communication with colleagues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them

special_situations.event: When receiving positive feedback or being recognized
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' approval does not count; only meeting the extremely high standards I set counts as being capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps raising standards, ignoring positive evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This praise does not mean I am really capable

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen as a competent and excellent Musician and Teacher, gaining recognition and enjoying the sense of meaning in music
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being seen through as not professional enough, being judged and negated, and ultimately being labeled a 'fraud'
defense_goal: By constantly raising standards and engaging in self-criticism to avoid being seen as not good enough
Keeping distance from colleagues to reduce being compared and judged
Seeking external approval to temporarily ease unease

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough Teacher/Musician who could be exposed at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of expressing difficulties to a spouse or colleagues and seeking support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes expressing will burden the other person, or draw others' judgment and contempt
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasize 'I do not want to trouble others' in a tactful, restrained tone, digesting problems alone instead, and reducing emotional exposure and requests for help.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing the high-level performance of Students/colleagues, or others' Silence and neutral feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting inner shame and Self-denial as others' negative perceptions (they will think I am not good enough)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using vague and avoidant expressions to reduce self-exposure, emphasizing that others 'might look down on me', thus avoiding further in-depth discussion.

manifestations: The experience of enjoying music decreases; practice and performance are dominated by self-criticism
Measures self-worth by others' standards; finds it hard to experience self-consistency at work
outcomes: Declining sleep quality and impaired attention

manifestations: Not sharing difficulties and feelings with a supportive spouse
Alienated from colleagues, reducing communication due to comparison
outcomes: Available support not yet utilized, Increased subjective sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: During practice/performance, highly focuses on errors and magnifies their meaning
Worried about burdening others and therefore not seeking help

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Wants to seek the spouse's support but chooses to endure and digest it alone
Turning the need for external help into doubled practice, raising standards to keep Anxiety down

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Clinging to the absolute standard of 'must be stronger than Students to be competent'
Treating others' approval as 'not counting', only acknowledging one's own capability upon reaching self-set high standards

positive_force: Has a supportive spouse (who can provide emotional support)
Having a professional foundation of many years of music training and multi-instrument performance ability
Proactively seeks counseling and is willing to try structured behavioral experiments and records
negative_force: Setting unrealistic goals and relying on external approval to affirm self-worth
Cognitive distortions: mental filtering, negating the positive, predicting the future, overgeneralization
Sleep and focus affected, Decline in work performance, estrangement from colleagues

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive self-criticism and comparison during practice and performance, accompanied by Anxiety and avoidant tendencies
antecedent: Seeing colleagues' or Students' high-level performance
When mistakes or difficult passages occur
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by cognitive distortions and impostor feelings (generalizing individual mistakes as 'completely not good enough', predicting exposure)
target_behavior.function: Avoids being judged and failure, trying to gain a sense of control through self-criticism
target_behavior.consequence: Work stress and burnout increase, enjoyment of music declines, and he becomes distant from colleagues

target_behavior.behavior: Setting unrealistic goals and continuously seeking external approval
antecedent: Facing advanced teaching tasks or professional evaluations
Feeling uneasy after comparing with others
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth overly dependent on external approval and absolute standards, negating positive evidence
target_behavior.function: Briefly easing unease, gaining others' Approval to maintain self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Stress and Worsened self-negation, sleep and focus affected, counterproductive in the long term
